note: Submodule of Mailgun. Purely presentation: hook_theme() registers three theme hooks (mailgun__test_form_email, mailgun__password_reset, mailgun__user), each a suggestion of the parent 'mailgun' theme hook, backed by Twig files in templates/. No config, routes, permissions, services or Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the LIVE theme registry and module-install state (no external API): medium confirms the example email theme hooks are registered; hard is installing the submodule so the hooks appear (reset uninstalls -> verify FAILs; enable -> verify PASSes). Cleanups leave the submodule enabled, which is the documented baseline.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal mailgun_email_templates_examples submodule give me, and do I need to configure anything to use it?
evals.expected_output: It ships example HTML email Twig templates (password reset, user, the Mailgun test email) via hook_theme() suggestions of the parent 'mailgun' theme hook. There is no configuration - enabling it is the whole setup; you customize by overriding the templates in your theme.

evals.prompt: Which theme hooks / template files does mailgun_email_templates_examples register, and what makes them apply to Mailgun's emails?
evals.expected_output: It registers mailgun__test_form_email, mailgun__password_reset and mailgun__user, each declared with base hook => 'mailgun' (so they are template suggestions of the parent Mailgun 'mailgun' theme hook). Templates are templates/mailgun--*.html.twig.

evals.prompt: How do I change the look of the Mailgun password-reset email provided by mailgun_email_templates_examples?
evals.expected_output: Copy templates/mailgun--password-reset.html.twig into your active theme's templates/ directory, edit it, and clear caches; the theme copy overrides the submodule's example.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the Mailgun example password-reset email template active? Inspect the live theme registry and name the theme hook that provides it.
evals.expected_output: Yes - the theme hook mailgun__password_reset is registered in the live theme registry (provided by mailgun_email_templates_examples, base hook mailgun).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live theme registry and tell me whether the Mailgun example USER-account email template is registered, and which theme hook name it uses.
evals.expected_output: Yes - the theme hook mailgun__user is registered in the live theme registry (provided by mailgun_email_templates_examples, template mailgun--user.html.twig, base hook mailgun).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, install the Mailgun example HTML email templates so that common emails (like the password reset) get the ready-made HTML templates. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the mailgun_email_templates_examples submodule (drush pm:install mailgun_email_templates_examples). Verify checks the module is installed and its theme hooks mailgun__password_reset / mailgun__user are present in the live theme registry.
